basis: The chart's title claims a decreasing trend, but the plotted line visually shows a clear increase from approximately 1100 new tourists in 1880 to approximately 3000 in 1891. The visual evidence of the plotted data is the authoritative source for the trend, as it directly encodes the values on the labeled axes (Year on x-axis, Number of New Tourists on y-axis, increasing upward). The title's assertion is contradicted by the plot. The public task directs to use the dashboard as the evidence source, and the most direct, evidence-based interpretation is that the trend is one of growth. Therefore, the route to tourism growth planning is the appropriate follow-up.
